# Moonlight

Moonlight ships matching dark and light variants, named Moonlight Dusk and Moonlight Dawn. Its recorded description names consistent interface, pane and editor styling as the aim of the theme.

![Moonlight screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kartik-karz/moonlight-obsidian/HEAD/moonlight-theme.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Moonlight"
    author: "kartik-karz"
    repo:   "kartik-karz/moonlight-obsidian"
    slug:   "moonlight"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/moonlight"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/kartik-karz/moonlight-obsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kartik-karz/moonlight-obsidian/HEAD/moonlight-theme.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply Moonlight for a clean, readable Obsidian interface with matching dark (Moonlight Dusk) and light (Moonlight Dawn) variants. Keep UI, panes, and editor styling consistent for a calm, focused writing experience."
}
```
